name: Sled
piloting: Driving Lore (DC 14) or Nature (DC 16 to DC 24, depending on pulling creature)
speed: the Speed of the slowest pulling creature (pulled by 2 Medium creatures or 4 Small creatures)

items.name: Ice Traverser
items.text: Ice and snow are not difficult terrain to a sled, but all other terrains are difficult terrain for it.

items.name: Sluggish
items.text: This vehicle must move twice its length for each 90-degree turn it makes.
